prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning (beds) or spray/airbrush (sunless) tans? And do you have a neighborhood or ZIP code in Charlotte?

If you want a quick answer now: I can’t look up live ratings from here, so instead I can help you pick the best salon for you by giving what to look for and some questions to ask. If you tell me which part of Charlotte you’re in, I can give tailored recommendations and step you through checking current reviews.

Quick guide to picking the best tanning salon
- Decide type: spray/airbrush (much safer, immediate results) vs. UV beds (carry skin-cancer risk).
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews and look at before/after photos on Instagram.
- Cleanliness & ventilation: salon should look modern and well-kept; spray booths should be ventilated and techs should wear masks.
- Technician skill and certifications: for airbrush, ask about experience and what solution brand they use (Norvell, Versa, Mystic, etc.).
- Ask about patch tests, how long the color lasts, and aftercare instructions.
- Equipment and options: look for red-light options or high-end beds if you prefer UV tanning; for spray, look for multishade/formula choice and airbrush vs. booth.
- Price and memberships: check package deals and whether they honor touch-ups/fixes.
- Safety and skin type advice: good salons will recommend formulas or tanning plans based on your skin tone and history.

Questions to ask a salon before booking
- Which sunless solutions do you use and do you offer samples/patch tests?
- Can I see recent before/after photos for clients with my skin tone?
- What’s the expected development time and how long will it last?
- How do you handle fixes if the color looks uneven?
- For UV beds: what types of beds do you have and what levels of exposure are recommended for my skin type?

If you tell me spray vs UV and your neighborhood/ZIP, I’ll list 3–5 salons in Charlotte with a brief pros/cons based on typical recent-review criteria and give a top pick.
